claim: Supplementary to F-STAT-006 (returned for evidence by R-A-007; F-STAT-006 preserved unchanged). The text of Army Rules r.192 differs between sources: MML 2.pdf p.227 prints a proviso (reduction to a lower grade of pay only to the immediately next lower grade, not effective beyond one year) footnoted as substituted by SRO 215 of 17-06-1965; the India Code compilation p.209 prints r.192(i)-(ii) without it. HCE-017 cites neither r.192 nor the proviso.
original_text: Check ceilings, coexistence of multiple awards, and any notified additional punishments.
proposed_text: Proposal only: cite AR r.192 with a flag that its proviso (SRO 215/1965) appears in manual copies but not in the India Code compilation; text unresolved pending the SRO.
rationale: Both pages checked against rendered page images by the orchestrator, confirming reviewer A. Neither copy is the Gazette; SRO 215 (1965) not held.
pinpoint: AR r.192: India Code PDF p.209; MML 2.pdf p.227
temporal_scope: r.192 as printed in the India Code compilation (retrieved 2026-11-21) vs MML 2 (undated edition; notes to 2003). SRO 215 of 1965 not held.
advisor_questions: Is the r.192 proviso (SRO 215/1965) part of the operative rule, and should the database flag its omission from the India Code compilation?
limitations: Same model family as first pass and reviewers.

claim: Re-scoping of F-MML-019 per R-A-020 (F-MML-019 preserved unchanged): MML 2.pdf p.89 note 6 states that s.121 'prohibits a second trial by court-martial or a criminal court'. Enacted s.121 (India Code p.35) bars a second trial only 'by a court-martial or dealt with under the said sections'. The vol 2(AA) note 6 tracks the section text; only its cross-reference to omitted s.127 is dead.
original_text: (MML 2.pdf p.89 note 6, ≤20 words) 'The section prohibits a second trial by court-martial or a criminal court or being dealt with again'
proposed_text: Proposal only: flag MML 2 p.89 note 6 as overstating s.121; flag vol 2(AA) s.21 note (a) and s.121 note 6 cross-references to omitted s.127 as dead references.
rationale: Page image of MML 2 p.89 and India Code s.121 text compared by the orchestrator; reviewer A's dispute upheld on the text. Whether a criminal court may try after court-martial (Art 20(2); CrPC s.300 / BNSS successor) is a legal question not resolved here.
temporal_scope: s.121 as consolidated on India Code (retrieved 2026-11-21); MML 2 edition undated.
advisor_questions: Confirm the scope of s.121 and whether any rule bars criminal-court retrial after court-martial (Art 20(2), CrPC s.300 / BNSS equivalent).
